newsitem.title: USA: Equus Gaming unit Q1 wagering falls.
newsitem.headline: Equus Gaming unit Q1 wagering falls.

text.p: Equus Gaming Company LP said Friday that El Comandante Operating Co Inc reported commissions on wagering at the El Comandante Race Track in Puerto Rico were $13.9 million for the quarter ended March 31, 1997.
Commissions were $15.2 million for 1996 period, which had 61 race days as opposed to 62 in the curren period, the company said.

"We are proactive in our efforts to identify and correct negative trends that we can control. We are already working on strategies to improve our first quarter performance in the months ahead," the company said in a release.

Equus has an 82 percent interest in Housing Development Associates SE, a partnership that owns El Comandante. El Comandante Operating Co leases the track and pays Housing Development 25 percent of wagering commissions as rent.

HDA also owns a 55 percent interest in Galapagos SA, which operates a government-owned race track and OTB agency system in the Dominican Republic. Galapagos recently announced that in June 1997 it begin will managing the wagering distribution system for a new national lottery in the Dominican Republic, which will allow a sharing of OTB and lottery outlets.
